title: Its ok
text: Its ok. Purchased to replace a working sweeper. It doesnt seem to pick up as well as my other sweeper. Its head rotates randomly when not needed at times making it awkward at times using it. Personally id go with another and will be getting another sweeper and giving this one away. Last black an decker sweeper for me back to bissel.

description: The black+decker airswivel ultra-light weight upright vacuum cleaner, versatile features 170-degree swivel steering. Unlike traditional vacuums which typically require two separate motors to accommodate swivel functionality, the patented airswivel technology only needs one motor, allowing for maximum maneuverability and ease of use. Includes 3-in-1 crevice tool with brush and upholstery tool to allow for vacuuming in narrow and hard to reach places, and Turbo pet tool for vacuuming pet hair on all surfaces.
